title: The Settings sub-toggles work independently (Service on, Finance off)
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON, the Service sub-toggle ON and the Finance sub-toggle OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Confirm the Service pages are shown.
  3. Confirm the Finance pages are not shown.
custom_expected: The Service pages are shown and the Finance pages are hidden — the sub-toggles work independently.
evidence: UI (role with Service ON, Finance OFF = SetX): the SERVICE pages show and there is NO FINANCE group — the Settings sub-toggles work independently.
